details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:466-500 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The release_blocker poller producer is listed as "orchestrate_poll.yml" in SOURCE_KINDS / REPORT_IDENTITY_WORKFLOW_BY_KIND (line 466/468), but the key in RELEASE_BLOCKER_PRODUCER_SCOPE_PATHS (line 482/495) is "internal-orchestrate-poll.yml"; verify_release_blocker_reporter_run (lines 2315-2320) checks against that dict and rejects orchestrate_poll.yml runs as workflow_path_mismatch.
  WHY: Both reviewers rate this BLOCKER: every Phase 3 poller release_blocker report would be dropped before diagnosis and send a WARNING on every tick, and the gate does not accept what the README and agents.d document. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disagrees and lists it as a verified false positive: for a workflow_call run, the run's `path` is the caller's file (internal-orchestrate-poll.yml), and orchestrate_poll.yml has only a workflow_call trigger.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6083-6128 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: compose_occurrence_comment writes the occurrence_at marker on occurrence comments of every source kind, and occurrence_throttled never checks the kind, so the gate's workflow_run occurrence comments on the shared heal issue throttle release_blocker duplicates (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 2258-2288).
  WHY: The stable gate keeps failing and keeps refreshing the marker, so the release_blocker never sends a WARNING, not even the first time; only DEBUG workflow_run alerts are sent, and the default threshold drops them.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3538-3565, 3626-3647 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: For a release_blocker, the consumer-app-defect arm opens a heal issue in SELF_REPO and the already-fixed arm drops the report, and both send only a DEBUG alert with no release_blocker WARNING branch.
  WHY: release_blocker sets issue_number to None, so the self-repo issue is always filed, and the default Telegram threshold of WARNING suppresses DEBUG; the README and changelog promise a WARNING (all reviewers rate it MAJOR).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2631-2637, 3601-3623 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Only the duplicate path is throttled; the pre-diagnosis skip and the consumer-config|transient no-issue arm send a fresh WARNING on every producer tick, and the consumer-config|transient arm also re-runs the WORKFLOW_HEAL diagnosis model call each time.
  WHY: A persistent blocker costs one LLM diagnosis and one WARNING per tick with no WORKFLOW_HEAL_OCCURRENCE_THROTTLE_SECS bound; severity disagreement: gemini and minimax say MAJOR, sonnet and glm say NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2255-2326, 3517-3533 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A newly filed release_blocker issue gets no occurrence_at marker (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6091 adds it only to later occurrence comments), so the next identical report posts an occurrence comment and sends a "still present" WARNING instead of being throttled.
  WHY: Every new blocker gives two back-to-back WARNINGs, which breaks the plan's acceptance criterion (docs/plans/release-blocker-heal-reports-plan.md:76); severity disagreement: luna says MAJOR, sonnet and glm say NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2291-2296, 2323-2325 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: When the occurrence comment POST fails (DUPLICATE_OCCURRENCE_STATE=failed), the release_blocker WARNING is still sent and no marker is written.
  WHY: Repeated comment-write failures become an unthrottled WARNING on every tick, and the alert does not say the occurrence was not recorded.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6083-6093, 5843-5866 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: For release_blocker, the occurrence comment still opens with "Another occurrence of this failure was reported:" and adds "- **Failed run:**" lines, while the issue body says "No workflow run failed."
  WHY: The wording contradicts the release_blocker framing and suggests failed-step logs that do not exist; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash lists this as a false positive (the run_refs are genuinely failed gate runs).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2264-2285, 2618-2620 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: build_blocker_payload silently drops run_refs beyond MAX_RUN_REFS (3), while validate_payload raises ValueError when the cap is exceeded.
  WHY: The dropped gate runs are never diagnosed and the producer is not told; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash lists this as a false positive (it matches the documented builder contract and causes no runtime failure).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2273-2277 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Every release_blocker duplicate does a paginated issue-comments read, an occurrence-throttle python run and a jq parse, even when the issue has not changed.
  WHY: Network and compute cost grows linearly with duplicate reports and the producer tick rate.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2266-2272 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The BLOCKER_THROTTLE_LOGIN resolution ladder can fall back to an ungated `gh api --method GET user` REST call on every duplicate, and if that fails, `--trusted-login ""` leaves the throttle with no effect.
  WHY: It costs one extra REST call per duplicate, and with a limited-scope PAT the throttle silently stops working.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Every blocker report results in a Telegram alert at WARNING or above" / "A filed issue, a consumer-config or transient verdict and a recorded repeat each send a WARNING."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh consumer-app-defect arm (lines 3538-3565) and already-fixed arm (lines 3626-3647)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither arm has a release_blocker branch in the PR diff, both still send only DEBUG (consumer-app-defect line 3564, already-fixed line 3646), and the README and agents.d fragment promise the WARNING
- requirement: "Repeats are throttled: a duplicate posts an occurrence comment only when the pipeline account recorded none on that issue within WORKFLOW_HEAL_OCCURRENCE_THROTTLE_SECS"
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh pre-diagnosis skip (~lines 2631-2637) and consumer-config/transient arm (~lines 3617-3619)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Only the duplicate-comments block (lines 2258-2288) calls occurrence-throttle; both no-issue paths send a WARNING unconditionally and run a fresh model call on every tick
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py (occurrence_throttled, about lines 6100-6128; compose_occurrence_comment, lines 6083-6093) together with scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh (the release_blocker throttle in the duplicate arm, lines 2258-2288) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The occurrence_at marker is written on every kind's occurrence comments, and occurrence_throttled ignores the kind, so the gate's workflow_run occurrence comments on the shared heal issue throttle the release_blocker duplicate (duplicate_throttled, no comment, no alert).
  WHY: The gate keeps refreshing the marker inside the 24h window, so the release_blocker never sends a WARNING; fix: write the marker only for release_blocker comments, or add the kind to the marker.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh consumer-app-defect arm, lines 3538-3565; already-fixed arm, line 3646 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A release_blocker (empty ISSUE_NUMBER) given a consumer-app-defect verdict opens a heal issue in SELF_REPO, and an already-fixed verdict files nothing; both alert only at DEBUG.
  WHY: The default threshold of WARNING suppresses DEBUG, so no one sees an alert; fix: add a `SOURCE_KIND = release_blocker` WARNING branch to both arms.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 2631-2637; 3617-3619 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The pre-diagnosis skip and the consumer-config|transient arm are not throttled, so every tick sends a WARNING and the consumer-config|transient arm re-runs the diagnosis.
  WHY: One LLM diagnosis and one WARNING per producer tick with no bound; no producer exists yet.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh duplicate arm, lines 2258-2326 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A newly filed release_blocker issue has no occurrence_at marker, so the next tick posts an occurrence comment and sends a "still present" WARNING.
  WHY: Two WARNINGs back to back; fix: use the issue's created_at as the marker age.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 2291-2296 and 2323-2325 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the occurrence POST fails, the WARNING is still sent and no marker is written.
  WHY: An unthrottled WARNING on every tick; fix: add "(occurrence comment failed)" to the WARNING text.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Every blocker report results in a Telegram alert at WARNING or above". Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, the consumer-app-defect arm (lines 3538-3565) and the already-fixed arm (lines 3626-3647). Evidence of absence: neither arm has a release_blocker branch, and both still send DEBUG. SEVERITY: MAJOR, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING (2 related items): scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 2266-2272: an empty BLOCKER_THROTTLE_LOGIN never throttles and logs nothing, so add an occurrence_throttle_login_unavailable warn log; scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py line 6084: for release_blocker, use "The release blocker was reported again:" as line 2. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
